summary: Tested the OFF 360 refactor (multi-establishment, per-establishment subscriptions, discount-config gating). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_off360_refactor.py with 16 tests -> 15 passed, 1 skipped (10-est limit not reachable). Verified: (a) /api/admin/overview: total_users == total_consumers + total_merchants (15==7+8) and total_establishments/active/pending/suspended reported separately; (b) merchant multi-establishment list & create (limit=10, new est is pending + discount_configured=false + discount_percent=null); (c) merchant PUT /api/merchant/establishment/{eid}: discount<1 or >100 -> 400, valid pct -> discount_configured=true; (d) admin /establishments/{eid}/activate flips ONLY that est to approved+active with next_due and writes audit; other ests unchanged; suspend also isolated; (e) /api/admin/subscriptions returns {rows,total,prices_configured} mixing consumer + establishment rows with all required fields, and filters type/status work; (f) /api/admin/consumers/{cid}/activate sets account_status+subscription_status active + subscription_start + next_due + audit + notification; (g) Tamires 'VETERINÁRIA - DR THAMIRES MARIANE' exists with discount_configured=false, discount_percent=null and is filtered OUT of /api/consumer/establishments; (h) consumer scan of newly-created (pending-approval) est returns 400 with 'não está ativo'; (i) consumer POST /api/consumer/transactions is correctly 400'd with the 'Configure o percentual de desconto para liberar as transações.' message when est has subscription active but discount_configured=false; (j) /api/merchant/dashboard?establishment_id=all returns view='all' with totals{establishments,active,pending,monthly_value} + per_establishment; a specific id returns view='single' with selected. Frontend (browser via Playwright): admin login (owner) -> /admin Overview renders 'Usuários (consumidores + empresários)=15' and 'Estabelecimentos=11' as separate cards; /admin/subscriptions renders real subscriptions-table with sub-type filter and Ativar/Suspender text buttons; /admin/establishments shows text buttons Ativar/Suspender/Reprovar with data-testid activate-est-<id> present (2 pending rows). Tamires row shows Pendente + 'Não configurado'. Merchant login (empresario@off360.com) lands on /merchant with est-selector = 'Todos os estabelecimentos', add-est-btn shows '4/10 unidades' and is enabled, consolidated dashboard shows totals + 'Por estabelecimento' table with 'Não configurado' for the 2 unconfigured ests; /merchant/establishment renders est-discount input. Code-verified data-testids that were not clickable due to session isolation between browser runs: activate-consumer-btn (Consumers.js:79), confirm-action (Subscriptions.js:101), confirm-est-action (Establishments.js:82), confirm-add-est (MerchantLayout.js:120).

minor.issue: Does NOT enforce establishment.subscription_status == 'active' nor establishment.discount_configured. Only approval_status is checked. Per PRD/requirement, a scan on an approved est whose subscription is suspended/pending or whose discount is not configured must return 400 with 'não está ativo' or 'Configure o percentual de desconto para liberar as transações.'. Currently returns 200 with the establishment payload (discount_percent may be null). Transaction creation still blocks correctly, so this is UX-only — user only sees the block after entering an amount. Reproducer: as consumidor@off360.com POST /api/consumer/scan {qr_token=<qr of TEST_NoDisc est with sub active + discount_configured=false>} -> observed 200 (should be 400).

action_items: Add subscription_status + discount_configured checks inside /api/consumer/scan so the block happens at scan time (matches the requirement wording 'QR/transactions are blocked with message: Configure o percentual de desconto para liberar as transações.'). Suggested: after existing approval check, add: if e.get('subscription_status') != 'active': 400 'Este estabelecimento não está ativo no momento.'; if not e.get('discount_configured') or not e.get('discount_percent'): 400 'Configure o percentual de desconto para liberar as transações.'
critical_code_review_comments: routes_consumer.scan checks only approval_status; transaction endpoint has the correct two-tier gating but scan lets the user through the QR step. Move the same guards into scan for consistency.

routes_admin.admin_update_establishment (PUT /api/admin/establishments/{eid}) copies subscription_status onto owner user document — this is dangerous once a merchant has multiple establishments (the owner user has no meaningful subscription_status anymore). Consider removing the users update or keying it off aggregate 'any est active'.
MAX_ESTABLISHMENTS = 10 is a hard constant in routes_merchant.py; consider making it a setting so admin can override without code change.
routes_merchant.dashboard 'new_customers' currently equals total distinct customers (not actually new-in-period). Cosmetic but the metric name is misleading.
routes_admin.subscriptions loads all consumers + all establishments in memory then filters/paginates in Python; fine at current scale but should move filters into the query for larger datasets.

activate_establishment always resets subscription_start to now on every call — reactivating a previously-active est loses its original start date. Consider preserving subscription_start if already set.

success_rate.frontend: All required data-testids present; admin overview cards, subscriptions table, establishments Ativar/Suspender, merchant est-selector/add-est-btn/est-discount all verified rendered.
